title.target: bù zǒu tóng yìtiáo lù de xìn
title.english: Letters That Do Not Travel Together

pairs.target: sè lā de xìn shì dìèrtiān wǔhòu dào de , gēn yìbāo gōngwū dìng de zhēnxiàn yìqǐ cóng chénglǐ zhuǎn lái . tā zài zhǐ shàng xiě le shōuxìn nàrì de rìqī , bǐ tǎ wéi zài fēng zhàn chāikāi tā zǎo liǎngtiān .
pairs.english: Sela's letter arrived the following afternoon, forwarded from the city with a package of sewing supplies ordered by the communal buildings. She had written the date she received his letter, two days before Tavi opened hers in Wind Trestle.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉的信是第二天午后到的，跟一包公屋订的针线一起从城里转来。她在纸上写了收信那日的日期，比塔维在风栈拆开它早两天。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng shǒushàng de mùxiè pāi jìng , nuó dào chuāng xià , xiāndú le tā xiě zài biānjiǎo de yíjù : chāo lái de xìn kànqīng le , fú lán yuán xìn réng zài zhēnxiànhé lǐ , méi náchū qù gěi rén chuán kàn .
pairs.english: Tavi brushed the wood shavings from his hands and moved beneath the window, first reading a line she'd written in a corner: she'd read the copied letter clearly; Fulan's original remained in the sewing box and hadn't been taken out for others to pass around.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将手上的木屑拍净，挪到窗下，先读了她写在边角的一句：抄来的信看清了，芙兰原信仍在针线盒里，没拿出去给人传看。

pairs.target: tā méi shuō zìjǐ zhīdào nàshuāng mùjī hòulái qù le nǎlǐ . tā zhī xiě , ā qiǎo xián zhòng yòu bùkěn tuō , ràng tā xiǎngqǐ tǎ wéi xiǎoshíhòu dé le yìshuāng shāo dà de xié , fēi shuō zhèng héjiǎo , yèlǐ hái xiǎng chuānzhe shàngchuáng .
pairs.english: She didn't claim to know where those wooden clogs went afterwards. She wrote only that Aqiao finding them heavy yet refusing to take them off reminded her of young Tavi getting slightly oversized shoes, insisting they fitted perfectly and wanting to wear them to bed at night.
pairs.hanzi: 她没说自己知道那双木屐后来去了哪里。她只写，阿巧嫌重又不肯脱，让她想起塔维小时候得了一双稍大的鞋，非说正合脚，夜里还想穿着上床。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú dào zhèlǐ xiào le , suíjí xiǎngbùqǐ nàshuāng xié shì shénme yánsè . tā jìde de shì sè lā dūn zài chuángbiān , līn zhe xiéhòugēn , jiào tā xiān bǎ jiǎo ná chūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed at that, then couldn't remember what color those shoes were. What he remembered was Sela crouching beside the bed, holding their heels and telling him to take his feet out first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读到这里笑了，随即想不起那双鞋是什么颜色。他记得的是瑟拉蹲在床边，拎着鞋后跟，叫他先把脚拿出来。

pairs.target: hòu bànyè shuō de shì jiālǐ de shì . xīn zhēn tào de huā cháowài , línjū kuā le liǎnghuí , dìsānhuí biàn jiè zhēn , tā zhī jièchū zuì cū de yìméi .
pairs.english: The second half-page was about home. The new needle wrap's flowers faced outward; a neighbor praised it twice and asked to borrow a needle the third time, so she lent only the thickest one.
pairs.hanzi: 后半页说的是家里的事。新针套的花朝外，邻居夸了两回，第三回便借针，她只借出最粗的一枚。

pairs.target: xīgài xiàyǔ shí réng suān , qíngtiān zǒu dào xiàngkǒu què bǐ shàng huí qīng xiē . tā wèn fēng zhàn de fàn shìbushì dōu hěn xián , jiào tā bié bǎ měifēngxìn dōu xiěchéng bàopíngān de dānzi , yǒu hǎoxiào de yě xiě yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Her knees still ached in rain, though walking to the alley entrance on clear days was a little easier than last time. She asked whether Wind Trestle's meals were all very salty, telling him not to make every letter a safety report: write a little of anything funny too.
pairs.hanzi: 膝盖下雨时仍酸，晴天走到巷口却比上回轻些。她问风栈的饭是不是都很咸，叫他别把每封信都写成报平安的单子，有好笑的也写一点。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ xìn fān huí qiánmiàn . chí ān jìde de xiǎoyuàn , tóng tā jìde de chuángbiān zhījiān , gé zhe tā zìjǐ yě shǔbùqīng de nián yuè .
pairs.english: Tavi turned back to the letter's beginning. Between the courtyard Chi An remembered and the bedside he remembered lay years he himself couldn't clearly count.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把信翻回前面。迟安记得的小院，同他记得的床边之间，隔着他自己也数不清的年月。

pairs.target: sè lā méiyǒu tì nàduàn kòngbái biān chū yìtiáo lù , yě méiyǒu wèn tā shénme shíhòu cái suàn wèn gòu . tā jiāng liǎngfēngxìn fēn kāifàng hǎo , yìfēng shì pángrén de tóngnián , yìfēng shì zìjǐ de jiā .
pairs.english: Sela hadn't invented a path through that blank or asked when he would consider his questions enough. He put the two letters away separately: one was someone else's childhood, the other his own home.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉没有替那段空白编出一条路，也没有问他什么时候才算问够。他将两封信分开放好，一封是旁人的童年，一封是自己的家。

pairs.target: xià róng qiāomén lái qǔ zuórì jiè kàn de bān biǎo , jiàn tā xiào , wèn shìfǒu yòu yǒurén péi táng . tā yáotóu , bǎ xiǎoshíhòu chuānxié shàngchuáng de shì shuō le . tā shuō nà dǎo kěyǐ shěngqù zǎochén chuānxié de gōngfū , jiǎngwán zìjǐ xiān xiào qǐlái .
pairs.english: Xiarong knocked to collect the timetable he'd borrowed to look at yesterday. Seeing him smile, she asked whether someone had given him compensation sweets again. He shook his head and told her about wearing shoes to bed as a child. She said that would save the time of putting shoes on in the morning, laughing first herself when she'd finished.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒敲门来取昨日借看的班表，见他笑，问是否又有人赔糖。他摇头，把小时候穿鞋上床的事说了。她说那倒可以省去早晨穿鞋的工夫，讲完自己先笑起来。

pairs.target: tā dàilái liǎngzhāng xīn xiě de shōujiàn zhǐ . zuórì yìdìng yōuxiān bāncì hòu , tái jǐng yǒu liǎngchù shōujiàn pù de jiē huòchē yào wǎn dào , jiù shíchén biàn jiē bú shàng .
pairs.english: She brought two newly written collection sheets. After yesterday's priority slots were agreed, incoming cargo carts for two Moss Well collection shops would arrive later, making the old times unworkable.
pairs.hanzi: 她带来两张新写的收件纸。昨日议定优先班次后，苔井有两处收件铺的接货车要晚到，旧时辰便接不上。

pairs.target: tā jīn zǎoyǐ qǐng shúrén dài huà , liǎngjiā dōu tóngyì xiàhuí wǎn bàn kè , dìsānjiā hái méi huíhuà , tā bùkěn xiān tìrén tiánhǎo . xià róng yòng shǒuzhǐ zài zhǐ shàng liáng chū yíduàn kōng chù , xiěxià dài wèn , wèn tǎ wéi néng bunéng jiè yìxiǎo jié xiàn , jiāng jiù dān tóng xīn dānxì zhù .
pairs.english: She'd already asked an acquaintance to carry a message this morning; both shops agreed to a slightly later time next run. A third hadn't replied, so she wouldn't fill it in for them in advance. Xiarong measured a blank space on the paper with her finger and wrote pending inquiry, asking Tavi for a short piece of thread to tie old and new sheets together.
pairs.hanzi: 她今早已请熟人带话，两家都同意下回晚半刻，第三家还没回话，她不肯先替人填好。夏绒用手指在纸上量出一段空处，写下待问，问塔维能不能借一小截线，将旧单同新单系住。

pairs.target: tā zhǎochū pǔtōng máxiàn , jiǎn le yíduàn gěi tā , méiyǒu dòng ā líng gěi de nà liǎnggēn xìshéng .
pairs.english: He found ordinary hemp thread and cut her a piece, leaving the two fine cords A-Ling had given him untouched.
pairs.hanzi: 他找出普通麻线，剪了一段给她，没有动阿绫给的那两根细绳。

pairs.target: xià róng xì zhǐ shí , tǎ wéi wèn gùdìng pǎo liǎngrì huì buhuì fǎndǎo gèng nán gǎi . tā xiǎng le yíxià , shuō zǒng bǐ měitiān yì xǐnglái dōu bù zhīdào shuí yào jiào zìjǐ hǎoxiē , zhǐshì yuányǐwéi tán chéng le biàn néng búzài tán , rújīn kàn hái dé fèi zuǐ .
pairs.english: While Xiarong tied the papers, Tavi asked whether two fixed days might actually be harder to change. She thought a moment: it was better than waking every day without knowing who might call for her, but she had thought reaching an agreement meant no more negotiating; apparently there was more talking ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒系纸时，塔维问固定跑两日会不会反倒更难改。她想了一下，说总比每天一醒来都不知道谁要叫自己好些，只是原以为谈成了便能不再谈，如今看还得费嘴。

pairs.target: tā zǒu hòu , tǎ wéi pūkāi liǎngzhāng xìnzhǐ . yìzhāng xiěgěi mǐlā , lìng yìzhāng xiěgěi yīwén . wěi guǎn , dǎoxià de bù shān , zuǐlǐsāi bǐng hái bùkěn lòu qiāo de gǔshǒu , tā xiě dào dìèrfēng shí réng xiào , bǎ dù chéng dāngshí de liǎn yòu tiān le yìbǐ .
pairs.english: After she left, Tavi spread out two sheets of letter paper: one for Mira, the other for Iven. The reed pipe, the fallen cloth mountain, the drummer who wouldn't miss a beat even with his mouth full of flatbread: he was still laughing at the second letter, adding another detail of Du Cheng's expression.
pairs.hanzi: 她走后，塔维铺开两张信纸。一张写给米拉，另一张写给伊文。苇管、倒下的布山、嘴里塞饼还不肯漏敲的鼓手，他写到第二封时仍笑，把杜澄当时的脸又添了一笔。

pairs.target: xiěgěi mǐlā de mòwěi wèn bǎshǒu fǎnfù kāihé shì dé rúhé , bìng méiyǒu tì tā xiě yígè yǐjīng chénggōng de jiéwěi ; gěi yīwén de zé shuō , zìjǐ zài huìshàng chàdiǎn zhī xiǎng ràng ruǎn héng dài dá , yǒuxiē huà zhēn lún dào kāikǒu , bǐ zài zhǐ shàng xiǎng shí nándé duō .
pairs.english: At the end of Mira's letter he asked how repeated handle-opening tests were going, without supplying her with an already successful ending. To Iven he wrote that he'd almost wanted Ruan Heng to answer for him at the meeting; some things were far harder when his turn came to speak than when thinking them out on paper.
pairs.hanzi: 写给米拉的末尾问把手反复开合试得如何，并没有替她写一个已经成功的结尾；给伊文的则说，自己在会上差点只想让阮衡代答，有些话真轮到开口，比在纸上想时难得多。

pairs.target: xiě wán péngyǒu de xìn , tā yòu gěi sè lā tiān le bànyè , bǎ xià róng nà jù chuānxié shěng gōngfū yě xiějìnqù . sānfēng gè zhé gè de , qùxiàng bùtóng , bùnéng yīn tóng zài zhuōshàng jiù hùnzuò yìbāo .
pairs.english: After finishing his friends' letters, he added half a page for Sela, including Xiarong's line about shoes saving time. He folded the three separately: different destinations meant they couldn't be bundled together merely because they shared a table.
pairs.hanzi: 写完朋友的信，他又给瑟拉添了半页，把夏绒那句穿鞋省工夫也写进去。三封各折各的，去向不同，不能因同在桌上就混作一包。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn ruǎn héng lái jiào tā héshí shí zuò bàogào lǐ de jǐchù dúshù .
pairs.english: At dusk Ruan Heng came to have him verify several readings in the practical-work report.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚阮衡来叫他核实实作报告里的几处读数。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ huà guòshǒu lù de nà zhāng tānkāi , ruǎn héng kàn wán , jiāng tā jiárù jì wéi lǎoshī de bàogào , lìng zhùmíng tiěliào yǔ jiājù réng zài xuégōng , qǐng tā jù yǐyǒu kǎohé ānpái xià yíbù , ér búshì qǐngqiú xiān gěi yìzhāng huànliào de xǔkě .
pairs.english: Tavi spread out his hand-route sketch. After reading it, Ruan Heng inserted it into the report for Teacher Vey, separately noting that the iron and fixture remained at the academy and asking her to plan the next step according to existing assessments, rather than requesting advance permission to change materials.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把画过手路的那张摊开，阮衡看完，将它夹入寄维老师的报告，另注明铁料与夹具仍在学宫，请她据已有考核安排下一步，而不是请求先给一张换料的许可。

pairs.target: liǎng rén dào jì jiàn chù shí , tiān hái méi hēi . tǎ wéi fù le zìjǐ sānfēng de yóu qián , bàogào zé yóu hé lù suǒfù .
pairs.english: It wasn't dark yet when they reached the mailing counter. Tavi paid postage for his own three letters; the Joint Routes Office paid for the report.
pairs.hanzi: 两人到寄件处时，天还没黑。塔维付了自己三封的邮钱，报告则由合路所付。

pairs.target: bànshì de rén bǎ tāmen fēnbié fàngjìn dài lǐ , tǎ wéi kàn le yíhuìer , cái zhuǎnshēn qù bāng ruǎn héng bān ménpáng dǎnglù de kōng kuāng . yuǎnchù wěi guǎn xiǎng le liǎngshēng , tíngzhù , yòu cóng dìyījù chóngxīn chuī qǐ .
pairs.english: The clerk placed them in separate bags. Tavi watched for a moment before turning to help Ruan Heng move an empty basket blocking the doorway. In the distance a reed pipe sounded twice, stopped, and started over from the first phrase.
pairs.hanzi: 办事的人把它们分别放进袋里，塔维看了一会儿，才转身去帮阮衡搬门旁挡路的空筐。远处苇管响了两声，停住，又从第一句重新吹起。
